core_obligations: Take a minimal relation for the last generator over the rational function field and show it is irreducible (proof lines 10528-10534).

Rule out the possibility that the polynomial lies in the p-th power subring, thereby exhibiting a generator whose removal leaves a separating transcendence base, and conclude separability (proof lines 10534-10566).
proof_roadmap: Choose a minimal relation and show it is irreducible (proof lines 10527-10534).
Exclude the p-th power case and read off separability (proof lines 10534-10567).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a field extension generated by a transcendence base together with one further element, under a linear independence hypothesis on p-th powers, some generator can be removed to leave a separating transcendence base (statement lines 10512-10525). The proof takes a minimal relation for the last generator, shows it is irreducible, excludes the case that this polynomial lies in the p-th power subring, and concludes separability (proof lines 10527-10567). Excluding the p-th power case is the step that decides which generator may be removed. H2.
